claims.lifetime: Volatile active stick state (0=none, 1=held unlit, 2=held lit); state 3 is reserved for a later swipe milestone. Never saved.
claims.reset: Cleared to 0 on boot, save/quit, game over, or damage/interruption. Set to 1 on menu draw and 2 on ignition; no swipe path is implemented.
claims.save: Volatile WRAM; not saved.

claims.lifetime: Volatile burn countdown ticks for active held stick; never saved directly.
claims.reset: Cleared to 0 on stow/drop. Initialized to stored wear budget (or 75 if fresh) on draw. Ticks down every 16 frames when lit.
claims.save: Volatile WRAM; not saved directly (remaining ticks copied to DekuStickWear on stow).

claims.lifetime: Reserved volatile swipe timer; the current draw/stow/wear milestone keeps it at zero. Never saved.
claims.reset: Cleared to 0 on draw, stow, drop, and boot. No Y-swipe initialization or completion path is implemented.
claims.save: Volatile WRAM; not saved.

claims.lifetime: Save file; persists remaining burn ticks (1-74) of a stowed lit stick across sessions.
claims.reset: Zeroed on new file initialization, on fresh stick draw, or when a fresh unlit stick is stowed. Populated with BurnTimer on stowing a partially burned stick.
claims.save: Inside vanilla EF000-EF4FF save buffer; physical slot/checksum mapping is separate.

claims.lifetime: Volatile Honeycomb or Deku Stick request queued during menu scroll-up and consumed by Menu_Exit; never saved.
